patch.summary: folk migration guide: inventory → rehearse → freeze → validate integrations — grounded in researched limitations and catalogue peers.

blocks.body: Migrate to folk by inventorying legacy crm fields, mapping them to folk objects, rehearsing a freeze window, and validating Gmail, WhatsApp Business before reopening writes.
bullets: Inventory → map → rehearse → cut over → reopen
Highest risk: Custom objects/Deals, email sequences, dashboards, workspace roles, and API access start on Premium.
Success signal: contact management works for the pilot cohort

blocks.heading: folk migration cutover playbook
blocks.body: Migrations fail from optimistic timelines — not from missing motivation.

scenarios.title: Field inventory
scenarios.body: Export legacy fields that power contact management, lead management, pipeline management and mark must-map vs archive.

scenarios.title: Rehearsal load
scenarios.body: Run a non-prod load into folk; measure match rates before the freeze.

scenarios.title: Production freeze
scenarios.body: Freeze legacy writes; cut over; validate Gmail; then reopen.

steps.label: Migrate when Founders and SMB teams running relationship-led sales from LinkedIn/email outweigh migration cost
Delay if this limitation hits cutover: Custom objects/Deals, email sequences, dashboards, workspace roles, and API access start on Premium.
If folk mapping is poor, compare destination fit with Salesflare before moving data twice

items.title: No freeze window
items.body: Dual-writing without a freeze creates irrevocable duplicates.

items.title: Integrations last
items.body: Wire Gmail in rehearsal — not on Monday morning after cutover.

items.title: Data risk 1
items.body: Custom objects/Deals, email sequences, dashboards, workspace roles, and API access start on Premium.

items.title: Data risk 2
items.body: Enrichment, magic fields, and AI assistant credits are monthly capped by plan (custom on Enterprise).

items.title: Data risk 3
items.body: FAQ references a free plan for downgrades, but live pricing cards emphasize Standard/Premium/Enterprise — free-tier feature limits are not fully documented on the pricing table.

checklist.label: Complete field inventory for contact management
Mitigate: Custom objects/Deals, email sequences, dashboards, workspace roles, and API access start on Premium.

notes: Migration: cutover risks, data mapping, checklist.
